# Copilot instructions

## Repository status

This repository is currently a minimal scaffold for **citech_lakbay_lokal**, described in `README.md` as a “Community Tourism Guide.” The README is the only tracked project file at present, so treat it as the source of truth until implementation, dependency, and CI files are added.

## Build, test, and lint

No build, test, or lint commands are defined yet. Do not assume a framework, package manager, runtime, or test runner; first inspect the files added for the relevant feature and follow their local configuration.

When tests are introduced, document both the full-suite command and the repository’s supported single-test form here.

## Architecture

There is no implemented application architecture yet. The intended product area is a community tourism guide, but domain boundaries, runtime components, data storage, and UI/API structure have not been established in the repository.

## Repository conventions

- Keep project-specific guidance and any setup or usage changes synchronized with `README.md`.
- Prefer conventions established by future dependency manifests, CI workflows, and feature-local configuration over introducing tooling by assumption.
- Keep this file focused on verified repository behavior; update it as the project gains an implementation, commands, and architectural boundaries.
